<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="0.4" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="psLHVpTyqoakyGVO2u6v"> <mxGraphModel dx="4023" dy="2505" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "erDiagram
 USERS ||--o{ PLAYLISTS : owns
 USERS ||--o{ SEARCH_HISTORY : records
 PLAYLISTS ||--o{ PLAYLIST_SONGS : contains
 SONGS ||--o{ PLAYLIST_SONGS : included_in
 SONGS ||--o{ SONG_ARTISTS : has
 ARTISTS ||--o{ SONG_ARTISTS : performs

 USERS {
 BIGSERIAL user_id PK
 VARCHAR_50 username UK \"NOT NULL\"
 VARCHAR_255 password_hash \"NOT NULL\"
 VARCHAR_100 full_name
 VARCHAR_150 email UK
 TEXT avatar_url
 TIMESTAMP created_at
 TIMESTAMP updated_at
 }

 ARTISTS {
 BIGSERIAL artist_id PK
 VARCHAR_100 external_id
 VARCHAR_150 name \"NOT NULL\"
 VARCHAR_150 normalized_name
 DATE birth_date
 VARCHAR_255 hometown
 TEXT biography
 TEXT image_url
 TIMESTAMP created_at
 TIMESTAMP updated_at
 }

 SONGS {
 BIGSERIAL song_id PK
 VARCHAR_100 external_id
 VARCHAR_255 title \"NOT NULL\"
 VARCHAR_255 normalized_title
 VARCHAR_255 composer
 INTEGER duration_seconds
 TEXT audio_url
 TEXT video_url
 TEXT thumbnail_url
 TIMESTAMP created_at
 TIMESTAMP updated_at
 }

 SONG_ARTISTS {
 BIGINT song_id PK, FK
 BIGINT artist_id PK, FK
 }

 PLAYLISTS {
 BIGSERIAL playlist_id PK
 BIGINT user_id FK
 VARCHAR_100 name \"NOT NULL\"
 VARCHAR_255 description
 TIMESTAMP created_at
 TIMESTAMP updated_at
 }

 PLAYLIST_SONGS {
 BIGINT playlist_id PK, FK
 BIGINT song_id PK, FK
 INTEGER position
 TIMESTAMP added_at
 }

 SEARCH_HISTORY {
 BIGSERIAL history_id PK
 BIGINT user_id FK
 VARCHAR_255 keyword \"NOT NULL\"
 VARCHAR_255 normalized_keyword
 VARCHAR_20 search_type
 INTEGER result_count
 TIMESTAMP searched_at
 }

 SEARCH_CACHE {
 BIGSERIAL cache_id PK
 VARCHAR_300 cache_key UK \"NOT NULL\"
 VARCHAR_255 keyword \"NOT NULL\"
 VARCHAR_255 normalized_keyword \"NOT NULL\"
 VARCHAR_20 search_type \"NOT NULL\"
 JSONB response_json \"NOT NULL\"
 TIMESTAMP created_at
 TIMESTAMP expires_at \"NOT NULL\"
 TIMESTAMP last_accessed_at
 }

 SEARCH_STATISTICS {
 BIGSERIAL statistic_id PK
 VARCHAR_255 keyword \"NOT NULL\"
 VARCHAR_255 normalized_keyword \"NOT NULL\"
 VARCHAR_20 search_type \"NOT NULL\"
 BIGINT search_count
 TIMESTAMP last_searched_at
 }",
